Backgammon Made Simple is an open-source project. Different parts of the project use different licences.

## Website code and executable materials

Original website code and executable materials are licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 only](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html) (`AGPL-3.0-only`). This includes JavaScript, CSS, Shiny code, executable Quarto documents, scripts, tests, and build tooling.

## Educational content

Original educational text, articles, lessons, diagrams, and explanatory figures are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) (`CC-BY-SA-4.0`).

When reusing this material, give appropriate credit, link to the licence and source, indicate whether changes were made, and share adaptations under CC BY-SA 4.0 or a compatible licence.

Suggested credit:

> Based on material from **Backgammon Made Simple** by Marty Gale and contributors. Source: <https://github.com/backgammon-made-simple/backgammon-made-simple.github.io>. Licensed under **CC BY-SA 4.0**. Changes were made.

## Data and third-party materials

Data releases use the licence stated with each release. Third-party code, fonts, engines, screenshots, quotations, and other materials retain their original licences. See the repository's [third-party notices](https://github.com/backgammon-made-simple/backgammon-made-simple.github.io/blob/master/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for details.

## Branding and trademark

The software and content licences do not grant trademark rights in the Backgammon Made Simple name, logo, favicon, or other official brand marks. Forks and adaptations should use their own identity and must not imply endorsement or official status.

## Full terms

The repository [licensing summary](https://github.com/backgammon-made-simple/backgammon-made-simple.github.io/blob/master/LICENSE.md) defines the scope. The unmodified licence texts are stored in the repository's `LICENSES` directory.
